Do I have to pay for return shipping?
Yes—return shipping is generally your responsibility for both returns and exchanges. Original shipping fees are non-refundable. For an exchange of an unused product due to a non-quality reason within 30 days, you’ll also need to cover the return shipping cost. If the return involves a quality-related issue, Momcozy’s warranty policy provides a return shipping label and covers the shipping cost. Hope this clears things up!
You can review the complete return and exchange terms here: https://momcozy.com/pages/return-exchange?ref=menu_9__3_img
For eligible website orders, you can begin the process through the self-service return center here: https://momcozy.com/apps/aftership-returns-center
Please keep in mind that the return center is intended for individual products. If your purchase is a set or bundle, the self-service route may not support the application, so the complete policy page will help you review the applicable instructions. You may also want to have your order details ready before starting, so the request can be matched to the correct purchase.
